creator: Alexander Terp
description:
From #153, batch 13, item 11.

```rad
fn show():
    print(LATER)
LATER = "defined below"
show()   // error[RAD20028]: Undefined identifier 'LATER'
```

Fails in `rad check` and at run time on main. Lambdas and command callbacks behave the same. Functions hoist, so a reader expects a body to resolve globals when it runs; the docs cover function hoisting and never say a body resolves names where it is defined.

Resolve globals at call time, or document the rule under SYNTAX.md's Scoping section and have the error say the name is defined after the function.
title: A function body cannot read a global assigned below the function definition
